entry_thesis: RTX closed at an all-time high of $212.16 on March 2, 2026 — the first trading day after the US/Israel launched strikes on Iran — surging 4.7% on direct war-consumption demand (850+ Tomahawk missiles fired, manufactured by RTX/Raytheon). The Fear/Greed Index has shifted sharply toward fear (~44 trending down) and VIX sits at ~25, meaning broader market rotation into defensives is underway. Sentiment momentum on defense is at peak narrative strength: WallStreetBets, financial media, and options flow are all converging on defense as the dominant theme, with RTX the clearest direct beneficiary of ongoing munitions replenishment.
risk: Defense stocks already surged 40%+ YTD entering March and trade at elevated ~32x forward P/E; if ceasefire signals emerge or conflict de-escalates faster than expected, the war premium reverses sharply.
catalyst: Ongoing Iran war munitions demand driving Tomahawk missile replenishment orders; sentiment narrative at peak momentum with media, options flow, and institutional buying all aligned on defense as the dominant early-March theme.
